purpose: Confirm the frozen V71 native-exploit NSESche profile against the unchanged strongest FaaSRank comparator on twenty untouched same-seed tapes before closing operational mechanism selection.

frozen_selection.selection_rule_already_applied: maximum minimum relative margin over V71 throughput, finite-only QPR and zero-as-zero QPR

comparator_scope.reason_single_comparator_is_sufficient_f: The complete V70 nine-baseline paired cohort identified sche_FaaSRank as the unique strongest mean for throughput and both QPR definitions. V72 confirms the selected mechanism against that strongest comparator only; the separate formal E2 matrix remains responsible for the paper's full algorithm panel.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit and push this plan before generating any E390-E409 run spec, tape or output.
Generate one twenty-run FaaSRank manifest and one twenty-run frozen NSESche manifest from the same full source.
Capture twenty base tapes once, derive twenty scale5 tapes and bind identical per-seed hashes to both methods.
Bind the frozen FaaSRank model to the comparator manifest; NSESche has no learned-model dependency.
Build all twenty NSESche references with attempt-one and zero-quarantine gates before online execution.
Run FaaSRank E390-E409 first, then NSESche E390-E409, strictly serially and without reading intermediate outcomes.
Require forty attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact pairing and one runtime identity before opening summaries exactly once.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across twenty paired seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run throughput/(latency*cost) across finite paired runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same QPR with zero-completion runs contributing zero over all twenty seeds.
analysis.gate: The frozen NSESche candidate mean must strictly exceed the same-seed FaaSRank mean for all three metrics; ties fail.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report per-seed candidate-minus-FaaSRank differences and BCa 95% confidence intervals without relaxing the strict mean gate.
analysis.success_action: Close operational mechanism selection, freeze faasrank_native_exploit_anchor for the next formal NSESche matrix, and preserve all V70-V72 artifacts.
analysis.failure_action: Retain all V72 artifacts, mark the selected profile unconfirmed, do not promote V71 B/C post hoc, and require a newly preregistered mechanism on seeds after E419.
